title: [LOGGED OUT] A "Latest news" card opens the "News" popup and "Close" closes it

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ and wait until loaded
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss"
steps.saw: Banner appeared at the bottom; clicked Dismiss

steps.text: Scroll down to the "Latest news" section
Is at least one news card with a picture, a date and a title shown?
steps.saw: Two cards: picture, 'November 10' + 'The Clan Competition is about to start!' and 'November 3' + 'They way down to Atlantis is about to open!'
Clicked the Clan Competition card; screenshot was taken mid-animation (dimmed page, popup not yet drawn)
Dialog named 'News' opened (accessibility tree: dialog 'News', heading 'News'). The heading 'News' is not clearly visible in the screenshot, only the news title; may be a wording issue

steps.text: Does the popup show a picture, a news title, a date and some news text?
steps.saw: Picture, title 'The Clan Competition is about to start!', date 'November 10', text 'Welcome the new spell in the Clan Competition: Tornado!...'

steps.text: Click the close (X) button of the "News" popup

steps.saw: Popup gone, Latest news section visible again
